name: Conic Finance omnipools, 2023-07-21: ETH pool read-only reentrancy (cloned after a failed first attempt) and crvUSD pool sandwich (replayed ten times by Yoink)
era: early-pbs-2022-23; before the 2023-08-07 mempool archive, so in-block evidence only; Flashbots-relay bid history exists for most blocks
verdict_reason: No bot beat a pending attacker tx in either Conic pool. (1) crvUSD pool: Yoink gen1 replays the attacker's sandwich (same Balancer flash loan, same crvUSD create_loan, same Curve swap and Conic deposit/withdraw sequence with identical round-number sizes, amounts re-derived from live balances) ten times in blocks 17743471-17743480, starting ONE BLOCK AFTER the attacker's own successful tx (17743470 idx 4). Copy: confirmed. Order: after, so late-copy, not a front-run. (2) ETH pool (read-only reentrancy): the first attacker 0x10db234e deployed a contract and its attack tx reverted (out of gas, block 17740901); 51 blocks / ~10 min later 0x8d67db0b redeployed the SAME creation code (one 20-byte address differs) and sent the identical calldata, succeeding at idx 0 of 17740955 for 1,724 ETH: post-failure-replay by an anonymous clone exploiter, not a bot beating a pending attack, and not returned. Neither case is 'post-hack arbitrage of an imbalance': the crvUSD copy is a replay of the attacker's exploit calls. In-block evidence only (no mempool archive before 2023-08-07).

On-chain, the profit-taking txs we traced sum to 13.581 ETH (attacker, 2 successful txs) + 125.824 ETH (Yoink gross, 10 txs). No USD conversion is saved, so no USD figure of ours is given.

sub_races.verdict_reason: The first attacker's attack tx (block 17740901 idx 4) reverted. 51 blocks (~10 min) later a different EOA deployed a byte-for-byte clone of the first attacker's contract (creation code differs in exactly one 20-byte address, the beneficiary), sent identical calldata (0x52558bb0, args 19700/240/3000/180) and succeeded at idx 0 of 17740955, taking 1,724.175 ETH. Nothing of the first attacker was pending in between (his EOA made only two txs ever). Not returned.
sub_races.assumption: Clone operator assumed distinct from the first attacker (redeployed instead of re-calling the first contract; separate Tornado funding about 52 hours earlier; older EOA with unrelated deploy history). A second wallet of the same operator is not excluded.

sub_races.verdict_reason: Yoink gen1 (EOA 0xfde0d157, contract 0xd050e0a4) replays the attacker's sandwich in ten consecutive blocks 17743471-17743480 at idx 0 (idx 4 once). The attacker's own tx 0x37acd17a landed at 17743470 idx 4 and succeeded, so the copy comes after. Call-by-call diff: every state-changing call (Balancer flash loan, crvUSD create_loan/repay, Curve crvUSD/USDC and crvUSD/USDT swaps, Conic deposit/withdraw, tricrypto exit) has the same target and selector in the same order; round-number sizes are identical, state-derived sizes differ in the 3rd-4th digit.

harmonized.verdict_reason: Yoink gen1 (bot 0xd050e0a4) replays the Conic crvUSD-pool attacker's sandwich in ten consecutive blocks 17743471-17743480 (idx 0, once idx 4). Call-by-call diff against the attacker's tx 0x37acd17a: same Balancer flash loan (12M USDC/80,000 WETH/9M USDT), same crvUSD create_loan(80,000 WETH, 93M, 10), same Curve swap and Conic deposit/withdraw sequence with identical round-number sizes; state-derived sizes differ ~0.1%. But the attacker's tx already landed at 17743470 idx 4 and succeeded (+11.56 ETH), so the first copy is one block AFTER it and nothing of the attacker's was pending (his next tx is 22 blocks later). Yoink took 125.82 ETH gross / 90.34 net (matches its on-chain message to <1e-5 ETH) against the attacker's 13.58 ETH, and returned 81.307 ETH (90.0% of net) to conicfinance.eth, keeping the 10% bounty. Not post-hack arbitrage of an imbalance (the earlier note) and not a front-run: a late copy.
